title: Mutate or Return
goal: Make a louder greeting. Which signature leaves the least machinery in the caller's hands?
hints: Count the muts each version forces into existence - including the caller's.
The pure version keeps the original AND produces the loud one. No mut anywhere.
explanation: Three legitimate shapes with different costs. In-place mutation infects the caller: their binding must go mut, and the original is gone. The consuming version contains its mut inside and chains nicely - one mut, hidden. The pure borrow-in/new-out version has zero mutable state and keeps the original available; it allocates the result, which is usually the honest price. Default to pure; reach for &mut only when profiling says the allocation matters.
